specific_objectives: 11.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the properties of atmosphere, flow over bodies, boundary layer.

practical: Review of IB diagrams on atmospheric layers; Instructor supervision required for diagram interpretation.
intro_questions: What is the primary composition of the Earth's atmosphere?
How does air behave when it flows over a solid body?
Why is the atmosphere divided into distinct layers?

topics: Flow over bodies and boundary layer
development.content:
Composition of atmosphere
Physical properties of air
Flow over bodies and boundary layer

Division of atmosphere
International Standard Atmosphere
Standard sea level values

Variation of pressure with altitude
Variation of temperature with altitude
Variation of density with altitude

summary_questions: Explain the significance of the International Standard Atmosphere in aviation.
Describe how air density changes as altitude increases.
Define the boundary layer in the context of flow over bodies.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note comparing geometric altitude, absolute altitude, and pressure altitude, referencing the concepts covered in LP 02.
